name: Marimo Regional Revitalization REIT, Inc.
summary: Marimo Regional Revitalization REIT, Inc. (hereinafter, “marimo REIT”) was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Real Estate Investment Trust Market as a diversified REIT with a portfolio of residential, retail, hotel and office properties (hereinafter, “diversified mix of income-producing real estate”) on July 29, 2016.
